anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Buffer differential pressure was 1.913 mbar, consistent with the earlier approximately 2 mbar baseline.
Buffer differential pressure rose to 5.728 mbar while system pressure fell to 395.962 mbar and distillate flow fell to 0.565.

Buffer differential pressure remains elevated at 3.244 mbar and column differential pressure has dropped to 0.029 mbar, despite system pressure recovering to 398.807 mbar and distillate flow to 0.668.
Both level switches remain at 1 and cooling-water flow is 4.554, within its observed range.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol setpoints and valve/pump command history are needed to distinguish a planned transition from a disturbance. Independently verify differential pressures and inspect the buffer/vacuum flow path to localize the cause; these readings alone do not identify a blockage or leak. Temperature instruments are not installed. A composition measurement and separation target are needed to assess separation.
